rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice when going back over a route, especially to find something or rediscover where you came from.

example.english: We can't find the shop we just passed, so we'll have to retrace our route.
example.traditional: 我哋搵唔返頭先嗰間舖，唯有行返原路。
example.jyutping: ngo5 dei6 wan2 m4 faan2 tau4 sin1 go2 gaan1 pou3 wai4 jau5 haang4 faan2 jyun4 lou6

rows.note: Use this specifically when tracing a line or drawing again rather than going back along a route.

example.english: This line was drawn crooked, so I need to retrace it.
example.traditional: 呢條線畫歪咗，我要再描條線。
example.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 sin3 waak6 waai1 zo2 ngo5 jiu3 zoi3 miu4 tiu4 sin3
